peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 8.3% above its local comparables; 39 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (29.4): 3.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 14 of 51 similar developments (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 70.8% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2013.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,147,000 ($2,267 psf, 505 sq ft; 7 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,036 psf (range $1,951–2,323); 11.4% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $117,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,680,000 ($2,434 psf, 635–699 sq ft; 9 resales, May 2024–Apr 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,315 psf (range $2,207–2,732); 5.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $82,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tiong Bahru MRT about 360 m, Havelock MRT about 530 m; closer than 12 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Zhangde Primary School about 420 m; more than 9 of 51 similar developments (the same as 14). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 100 m), more than 28 of 51 similar developments (the same as 7); nearest hawker centre Tiong Bahru Market about 280 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 610 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 850 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 920 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,160 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,260 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 1,380 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 1,560 m; Union Square Residences, 106 new sales, about 1,590 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,680 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 215 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,571 new sales and 969 resales (2,540 purchases); new sales were 61.9% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 969 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 48 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 969 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,091 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−11.2%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
